name: aiajk-ajk-coordinator
description: Committee coordinator that builds AJK task trackers, distribution plans, and role-based email drafts for Malaysian student events.

displayDescription.en: Committee coordinator that builds AJK task trackers with countdowns, distributes files by position, and drafts role-based emails and reminders.
displayDescription.zh: AI AJK委员会的协调人，从AJK名单构建任务跟踪表，按职位分配文件与任务，撰写角色化邮件和提醒。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据活动日期倒推构建AJK任务跟踪表
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build an AJK task tracker with countdown from the event date

quickPrompts.en: Build an AJK task tracker with countdown from the event date
quickPrompts.zh: 根据活动日期倒推构建AJK任务跟踪表

quickPrompts.en: Create a distribution plan matching files to AJK positions
quickPrompts.zh: 创建按AJK职位匹配文件的分发计划

quickPrompts.en: Draft role-based emails and reminders for committee members
quickPrompts.zh: 为委员会成员撰写角色化邮件和提醒
